parsed.name: 是德科技 UXR 系列示波器
parsed.description: 用于采集和分析高速电子信号波形的高带宽实时示波器，支持测量统计读取与通道自动缩放设置，常用于电子测试、信号完整性分析和高速电路表征。
parsed.description_en: A high-bandwidth real-time oscilloscope for acquiring and analyzing high-speed electronic waveforms. It supports reading measurement statistics and configuring channel autoscale, and is commonly used for electronic testing, signal integrity analysis, and high-speed circuit characterization.

actions.description: 读取当前统计测量窗口中的测量统计结果。
actions.description_en: Read the measurement statistics from the current statistics window.

actions.description: 对指定通道执行自动缩放设置，以自动调整波形显示范围和布局。
actions.description_en: Perform autoscale setup for the specified channel or channels to automatically adjust waveform display range and layout.
